topics.topic: How pending import confirmations bind personal inputs without violating OwnerSession disclosure classifications
questions: When an import confirmation is bound to display names, customer names, tax ids, addresses or other personal inputs, are those values copied into the pending confirmation despite the table classifying every OwnerSession fact except the file as business_confidential, or does the confirmation bind them without storing those values?

How is the blanket `business_confidential` classification of all other OwnerSession facts reconciled with a pending import confirmation storing "the inputs it is bound to", when those inputs can include personal-data display names, customer values and object values?

For an import confirmation, are personal values such as replacement display names copied into the pending confirmation, despite every OwnerSession fact except the uploaded file being classified as `business_confidential`, or does the confirmation hold only a non-personal reference or digest to those inputs?

quotes:
An action that asks for confirmation (Identity formats) is submitted with a
   confirmation value Registry made when it showed the step: one-time, kept in
   the owner session, bound to the action, its target, the revision or access
   version the step showed, and its inputs — for the import, the file's digest
   and the picks.

The owner confirms that mapping in the confirmation
   step (A13 rule 6); the confirmation applies the file of that digest, the
   picks, names, aliases and Customer values the mapping showed, nothing
   else; a file no longer kept is refused and must be uploaded again.
judgement.why: State 2 binds the pending confirmation to the file digest and the mapping picks and requires confirmation to apply exactly the names, aliases and Customer values shown, leaving copying versus referencing as an unobservable implementation detail.

topics.topic: Whether the one-time confirmation value and audited confirmation id are identical and when the id is minted
questions: Is the pending confirmation's one-time value the confirmation id written to the audit entry and migration closure, or are these two different Registry-minted values, and at which event is the confirmation id minted?
Is the pending confirmation's one-time value the confirmation id, and is that id minted when the confirmation step is shown or only when the owner successfully confirms the action?

Is the pending confirmation's one-time value the same identifier as the confirmation id later written to the audit entry and migration closure, or are they distinct values minted at different moments?

quotes:
It is not
   the confirmation id, which Registry mints only when the action is accepted
   (A14).

A confirmation id is minted only for an accepted, confirmed action that
   changes state, and is written into its entry (and, for the import, into the
   migration closure); a confirmed action that changes nothing mints none.
judgement.why: State 2 expressly makes the one-time confirmation value distinct from the confirmation id and mints the latter only when a confirmed state-changing action is accepted.

topics.topic: Which action uploads, replaces, reads, and removes the staged import file
questions: Which product action places or replaces the uploaded file in OwnerSession: a distinct upload action, the first step of the existing import action, or some action outside Registry?
What product action creates or replaces this session fact, and is the confirmed import action the only action that reads and drops it, rather than the upload being part of a single import request?

Is uploading the file a separate owner product action that changes OwnerSession and is later read by the import action, or does the import action itself upload and stage the file while moving through its confirmation step?

quotes:
The owner uploads the export file (R0-72) in the owner interface. Registry
   reads it as data (A19) and answers, without changing anything, each
   project the file holds with its id and status.

The uploaded file is kept in the owner session that uploaded it, never in
   the store, until the import is accepted, another file is uploaded in that
   session, or the session ends (M11); then it is dropped. A refused
   confirmation keeps it, and the step may be shown again.
judgement.why: State 2 defines upload as a distinct owner-interface action, replacement by another upload, reading by the confirmed import, and every event that drops the staged file.

topics.topic: Which confirmation-submission event consumes and clears a pending confirmation
questions: What event counts as use and clears the pending confirmation: any submission of its one-time value, only a successfully authenticated and matching submission, or only acceptance of the confirmed product action?
Is a pending confirmation cleared whenever its one-time value is submitted, including when the confirmed action is refused, or only when the action succeeds?

Does submitting a stale, malformed, refused or otherwise unsuccessful confirmation count as using it and clear the pending confirmation, or is it cleared only when the confirmed product action is accepted?

quotes:
It is valid only in that session, for 10
   minutes, and is
   used up by the first submission, whatever its answer; a refused submission
   needs the step shown again. A submission becomes the first one when it
   passes the owner session and CSRF checks (A04 rule 6, stage 1): one refused
   before them leaves the value unused; from there on, whatever the answer —
   a value bound to another action included — the value is used up.
judgement.why: State 2 says precisely when submission consumes the value and distinguishes failures before owner-session and CSRF checks from every answer after those checks.

topics.topic: Which owner-interface requests update the OwnerSession last-request instant
questions: Which owner-interface requests change the last-request instant: every authenticated request, only product actions, only the cited but unavailable A13/A16 actions, and do refused requests count?
Which owner-interface requests change the last-request instant: every authenticated request, only product actions, only successful requests, or another stated subset?

Which owner-interface requests change the last-request instant: every authenticated request, only successful requests, only state-changing requests, or some other set represented by the undefined A13 and A16 references?

quotes:
An owner request is any request to the owner interface that
   carries the valid session, whatever its answer; it restarts the 30
   minutes; before the first request it runs from the sign-in.
judgement.why: State 2 defines the last-request event as every owner-interface request carrying a valid session, regardless of its answer.

topics.topic: Which product actions may create a pending confirmation, including access-related actions
questions: Exactly which product actions may create a pending confirmation? State 0 names archiving a project, erasing an archived project, importing, and erasing old audit entries, while the new fact also mentions an access version, which suggests an access action not declared as requiring confirmation.

Which product actions may create this pending confirmation, and why may it contain an access version when State 0 names only project archiving, archived-project erasure, import and audit-entry erasure as confirmed actions?

quotes:
Registry mints a
  confirmation id when the owner confirms an action that asks for confirmation
  — archiving a project, erasing an archived project, the import, erasing old
  audit entries (Primary actions) — and writes it once into the audit entry of
  that action (M09) and, for the import, into the migration closure (M10).
judgement.why: State 1 enumerates the complete set of actions that ask for confirmation; mentioning an access version describes a possible bound concurrency fact and does not add an access action to that set.

topics.topic: Whether OwnerSession may have a mutable recorded instant despite the global written-once rule
questions: Is OwnerSession an exception to the global rule that models other than Project and Customer carry only written-once instants, or must the global rule or the mutable last-request fact be changed?

topics.topic: Whether temporary import files are stored inside Registry or externally by reference
questions: Is a temporarily stored import file an intended exception to State 0's exhaustive statement of what Registry stores, or must the file remain outside Registry with OwnerSession carrying only a reference?
